Record Class Database.HourlySales

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
Database.HourlySales
Record Components:
hour - the hour of the day, 0-23
orders - the number of orders in that hour
sales - the total sales in dollars
tax - the total tax collected in dollars
tips - the total tips in dollars
cash - the sales paid in cash
card - the sales paid by credit or debit card
other - the sales paid any other way, such as gift card or mobile
Enclosing class:
Database
public static record Database.HourlySales(int hour, int orders, double sales, double tax, double tips, double cash, double card, double other) extends Record
One hour of the X-report; hour is 0-23 and the payment columns split sales by how customers paid.
